stops.note: 'gift of God', theos 'god' + dōron 'gift', a popular Christian name
a pet form of Theodore; on a Mississippi hunt in November 1902, President Theodore Roosevelt refused to shoot a tethered bear, and Clifford Berryman's cartoon of it went national
Brooklyn shopkeeper Morris Michtom sold stuffed 'Teddy's bears', while Germany's Steiff company produced its own toy bears at the same time
